explanation: The theorem says two Qbar-algebra homomorphisms out of the library-specific field FB Γ are equal if they agree on its generators. The generators are the q-expansion quotients of integral-q-expansion modular forms. Its proof applies Mathlib's generic `IntermediateField.algHom_ext_of_eq_adjoin` to the library's own fact `FB_eq_adjoin`. Mathlib has no statement about FB Γ, `IsIntegralQExp`, `coeffEmb` or `intSeriesC`. The mathematical content therefore sits in the library's own definitions and in `FB_eq_adjoin`, so no Mathlib declaration duplicates it or yields it as a short special case. I did not run any searches in the Mathlib sources.
